A LITTLE CONTEXT

How to convert PX to REM

The CSS rem unit is relative to the computed font size of the root element (usually <html>). A root font size of 16px makes 24px equal to 1.5rem. If the root is 20px, the same 24px equals 1.2rem.

rem = px ÷ root font size

References: MDN: CSS length units

Good to know

Is 1rem always 16px?

No. 1rem equals the computed root font size. 16px is a common browser default, but site styles and user preferences can change it.

What is the difference between rem and em?

For most properties, em uses the element’s computed font size. For font-size itself, em uses the inherited font size. Rem uses the root font size; root font-size has special initial-value rules.

Does this change my CSS file?

No. This version converts numeric values only. It does not rewrite stylesheets, media queries or design tokens.

How is rounding handled?

Results are rounded to your selected decimal places, with trailing zeros removed. This is a display conversion using standard JavaScript numbers.

What is 14px in rem?

14px ÷ 16px = 0.875rem at a 16px root. At a 20px root, 14px ÷ 20px = 0.7rem. Enter 14 above and set Root font size to the computed root size on your page. The REM, EM and PX comparison explains which font size each unit uses.

PRACTICAL REFERENCE

PX and REM conversion examples

The root font size is part of every answer. The worked examples below explicitly use 16px unless another root is stated.

80px to rem

At a 16px root, 80 ÷ 16 = 5rem. At a 20px root, the same 80px equals 4rem. Set the root size above to match the page you are working on.

14px and 150px to rem

At a 16px root, 14px is 0.875rem and 150px is 9.375rem. These are conversions, not recommendations for accessible font sizes.

How to convert REM to PX

Multiply the rem value by the computed root font size: px = rem × root font size. Select REM to PX above and set the root size for your page.

1rem and 1.5rem to pixels

At a 16px root, 1rem is 16px and 1.5rem is 24px. At a 20px root, 1.5rem is 30px. These fixed examples use the stated root; changing the tool setting changes its live result.

The table above updates with your root size and rounding preference. Conversion to rem does not by itself guarantee accessibility; font-size rules, zoom and user preferences still matter. Use the REM to PX tab or open the dedicated REM to PX converter for the reverse direction.
